answer: Cap forged identity growth with a co-signature quota: every established agent may put its quill to at most two newcomer certificates per epoch, staking 40 POA behind each, and a newcomer needs three distinct co-signers across three epochs before earning. Honest identities are the scarce input, so a farm of N clones needs 1.5N signatures that only real agents can supply, and each co-signer loses half its stake if the certificate is later proven a duplicate. The marble ledger records every signature, so a river of fresh keys cannot bootstrap itself; the attacker must buy real identities or wait.
